Game Overview

In Color Blocks, the core idea is straightforward: strategically drag and drop blocks to fill grids, clearing columns or rows without leaving gaps. A simple yet addictive puzzle experience, keep the grid open and avoid running out of space. Master this challenge and see how long you can last in a colorful game of wits and precision.

How to Play

Getting started in Color Blocks doesn't take long to learn. Strategically drag and drop blocks to fill grids, clearing columns or rows without leaving gaps.
